desc: Ideation: divisor-of-L union approach, complexity O(T log T), correctness argument
Implement DSU (path compression + union by rank) indexed by value (array size T+1) for present values ≤ threshold
Filter nums: values > threshold each contribute +1 to answer, excluded from unioning
Build divs[L] lists: for each present v ≤ T, append v to divs[m] for each multiple m of v ≤ T
For each L in 1..T, union all elements of divs[L] with divs[L][0]
Count distinct roots among present values ≤ T, add count of values > T, return
Verify with examples ([2,4,8,3,9], T=5 → 4; [2,4,8,3,9,12], T=10 → 2) and edge cases (n=1, threshold=1, all isolated)
